extracted.name: Turkey Club Wrap
extracted.description: Turkey Club Wraps filled with turkey (or rotisserie chicken), bacon, lettuce, tomato, cheese and avocado. This 15-minute meal makes a great lunch or quick dinner and is nutrient packed to keep you full.
ingredient_lines: 2 heaping cups shredded leftover turkey or rotisserie chicken
8 slices cheddar cheese (, or your favorite kind of cheese)
instruction_lines: Season turkey with salt and pepper.
Spread a layer of mayonnaise and mustard over each tortilla.
Top each with 2 slices of your favorite cheese and cooked bacon and a handful of turkey, lettuce, tomato and avocado.
Roll and fold each tortilla, burrito style. Cut in half and serve.
